in_marathi.name: Mrinmoy
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Jewel of the mind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mrinmoy हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mrinmoy is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'mrin' meaning 'jewel' and 'moy' meaning 'mind'. This name signifies that the one bearing it is a treasure of wisdom and knowledge. It is a name given to those who are considered the bearers of profound knowledge, scholars, and thinkers.
